notes.title: Get Awe at half-price during the Steam Holiday Sale!
notes.notes: Steam's Holiday Sale starts on December 22 at 10:00 a.m. PST and BadLand Development Studio has prepared a merry little Christmas world for Awe.  This nifty little puzzle game will feature Christmas themed planets with objects like the Three Wise Men, Santa and his sleigh, reindeer, gingerbread men and more!  From December 22nd to January 4th, buy Awe for just $0.49 and bask in the joy that comes from puzzling your way through Awe's totally chill Christmas edition.

notes.title: An AWE-fully spooky Halloween Deal!
notes.notes: Things are about to get frightful in the Awe universe with the arrival of an Awe-fully spooky Halloween theme!  Expect dark trees, cats, rats, owls, witches, tombs, sinister hands, jack-o-lanterns, crypts, caramel apples, spiders and cobwebs.  Is it a ghoulish trick or a sweet treat?  Find out for yourself this weekend! Don't have it yet? Get it with a 10% discount from October 29th at 10:00 AM PST until November 2nd 10:00 AM PST!
